request: Create a 3D low-poly jungle monkey adventure prototype for Windows PC. The monkey can run, jump and collect bananas. Include a follow camera, a score HUD and a restart. No climbing, no swinging, no swimming, no weapons and no Android support.

overview.summary: Build a low poly 3D adventure game featuring a monkey set in a jungle environment.

engine.warning: No engine installations were supplied, so the selected engine could not be verified.

characters.retargeting_warning: Do not retarget humanoid locomotion clips blindly onto a monkey; verify spine chain, limb proportions and rest pose.

environments.scale: one playable slice first; size decided after the traversal test
collision_requirements: no pass-through on tree trunks, rocks and buildings
slopes walkable up to the configured limit
environments.weather: only if explicitly requested; it is not part of the core loop
environments.asset_density: start sparse, measure frame time, then add set dressing

performance_budget.fps: 60 fps at 1080p on the reference machine
performance_budget.budget: Keep draw calls below ~2,000 and total scene triangles below ~2M.

retargeting_order: source rig -> bone map -> rest-pose check -> scale check -> test clip -> engine import -> playback test
incompatibilities: Humanoid locomotion clips are not automatically compatible with quadruped characters; check bone names, chain lengths and rest pose before retargeting.
animations.acceptance: Every clip plays on the target character in the engine, with the correct root motion and loop behaviour.
